admission.justification: The verdict template variants and the Reviewer text must agree on one section, so a verdict cannot leave out which catalogs were bound.

conditions: The verdict template's Catalog Binding section is filled with the review type, the catalogs its table gives and, for each conditional catalog, whether it is bound and why.
exclusions: The catalog contents themselves, which belong to the criteria files.
statement: Every verdict has a Catalog Binding section naming the review type, the catalogs its table gives and, for each conditional catalog, whether it is bound and why; doctrine is bound when role files are included.
